title: Can You Trust Your Model's Uncertainty? Evaluating Predictive Uncertainty Under Dataset Shift
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating predictive uncertainty and calibration of deep learning models under dataset shift. While it touches upon applications in 'high-stakes' domains like medical diagnoses and self-driving cars, and uses terms like 'trust' and 'meaningful confidence', these are discussed in a technical capacity regarding model reliability and performance, not as an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics. A brief mention of 'AI safety' in a referenced paper (Amodei et al., 2016) does not make this paper primarily about faith or ethics.
